scrolled.label: Dark corridor ahead to the north, map panel scrolled to row 24 (dungeon row 30)
scrolled.explanation: A Warrior with a Wand of Light stands at dungeon row 30, which is row 6 of a 22-row map panel scrolled to row 24. The grid just beyond the torch light to the north is unknown, so the Borg wants to light the corridor. Original: the panel-edge test compares row 30 with 22 - 2 = 20 and refuses. Corrected: it compares row 6 and aims the wand north (keys a e 8).
